planned.policy: Separate fresh WebGLRenderer/V5World instances for direct and history paths. History renders all preceding macro clip midpoints plus explicit transition anchors and target neighbors. Each step invokes actual renderer.render and gl.finish. Raw world-only PNG pixels are compared exactly; no subtitle overlay can hide scene differences.

limitations: Exact frame-history independence on the listed tested paths, not a full-film frame-by-frame visual approval. No production source or video writes. Shader and pixel checks require an additional human review of the output PNG pairs.
